checks.same_original_mutex: Pinned path plus exact lock device/inode checked before acquisition, after acquisition before claim, and each holding iteration; parent identity checked in lock_identity.
checks.root_request: Exact path, CLI-pinned exact byte digest, exact 17-field key set, duplicate-key rejection, true boolean authority, fixed paths and metadata; no root request created or consumed live.
checks.cutoffs: Epoch 1791013030.8303788 is exact. Root-supplied integer monotonic cutoff is checked positive <=2**63-1, echoed unchanged, and shared by waiting and holding. No clock/budget reset.
checks.predecessor: Fixed source/claim paths, byte hashes, PID 1969270, unit er8-v8-root-durable-20261002-2348.service and exact predecessor metadata checked before waiting and again before claim; no predecessor writes/signals/unit operations.
checks.symlink_and_inode: O_NOFOLLOW on every opened parent component and input; lock/parent identities retained. Content-pinned request/predecessor reads check stability within each read, not permanent object provenance across reads.
checks.ownership_and_claim: LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB waits on original lock. Distinct O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW claim cannot overwrite existing claim or symlink. Claim says exclusive_flock_only, predecessor_exit_proven=false, native_case_activation=false.
checks.bounded_sleep: Every sleep is nonnegative min of 0.2 seconds and remaining original epoch/monotonic cutoffs; acquisition grants no new duration.
checks.forbidden_operations: Static import/call inspection found no subprocess, exec/eval, signal, fork, thread, unit launcher, provider/native activation, profile/auth/candidate/eval/ledger/sibling access. File operations are confined to fixed admitted inputs and distinct claim.
checks.failure_handling: Own descriptors close on expiry/failure. Write/fsync synthetic failures retain own incomplete/complete distinct claim for inspection, preserve collision on retry, and release flock.

limitations: This is exact source/test acceptance only. No live mutex/request/claim access, unit launch, MainPID proof, predecessor natural-exit proof, provider/native call, profile/candidate/ledger/sibling inspection, or canonical edit occurred.

Root must construct and hash its concrete request with the unchanged native_global_cutoff_monotonic_ns from its own original authority; the source cannot independently compare that value to an unread authority file.

Identical-byte atomic replacement of a request/predecessor source/predecessor claim at the same admitted path is accepted across separate validations. Tests observed changed input inode, unchanged byte digest/authority, unchanged parent/lock identity, and sole flock acquisition. This preserves content/path authority but does not establish permanent input-object provenance.
Tests use unchanged copied source and original test bytes with temp paths, mock predecessor hashes and clocks; no live predecessor bytes or original lock stat were independently verified.

Real service integration, real predecessor exit timing, real storage stalls/durability and service termination remain untested. Synthetic write/fsync exceptions were tested. Input/source/request validation occurs before waiting and again before claim, not continuously throughout holding.
